name: Vanirya Legends
storyline: In a medieval fantasy world filled with dangerous creatures and forgotten ruins, an adventurer sets out to forge their own legend. Through battle, exploration, and the forging of powerful equipment, they grow stronger, overcome ever-greater challenges, and ascend to new heights of power.
summary: Vanirya Legends is a browser-based fantasy idle role-playing game. Players progress through maps and boss encounters with automated combat, collect and upgrade equipment, customize character builds, and ascend to continue their progression. The game also features pets, expeditions, castle defense, guilds, a player market, and player-versus-player battles.
